description: This file defines structures and classes related to ISO 639 language codes, including a struct for language entries and a class for handling language selection and properties within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class representing a language, providing methods to access language codes, description, and ID, as well as comparison operators.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying language data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the language object has a valid selected language.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the description of the language or 'Unknown' if invalid.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Private method to find a language by name or ID.
